character: ANAT5 source-led Ming/Qing Chinese ink portraits

parts.construction: Master character root; preserve the source three-quarter facing and full bust placement.
parts.topology: All scholar parts remain connected to this root; head, beard and robe are separate overlapping layers.
parts.contour_plan: Align head and robe envelope to the rightmost anonymous sitter in Met 55.37 IIIF 161536.
parts.layering_plan: Paper -> robe -> neck -> face -> beard -> cap/ear details; preserve hidden overlaps.

parts.construction: ANAT1 is a deformable understructure only; source-authored contour defines the visible skull, temple, cheek and jaw.
parts.topology: Keep face contour, cap, ears, neck and beard as separate semantic paths; verify near/far feature visibility.
parts.contour_plan: Source crop anchors at cap corners, temple inflection, zygion, gonion and menton; do not use the raw generic oval as final contour.
parts.layering_plan: Head under cap; ear behind face; beard overlays lower cheek/chin; neck attaches under gonion and menton.

parts.construction: Source-specific face plane and outer contour over ANAT1 landmarks; maintain the source three-quarter view.
parts.topology: Independent left/right face planes and contour breaks; preserve asymmetry.
parts.contour_plan: Cubic curves follow temple, cheek fullness, jaw taper and chin; avoid one smooth ellipse.
parts.layering_plan: Skin base -> cheek/temple wash -> nose and under-eye wash -> feature marks -> beard overlap.

parts.construction: Separate near/far narrow eye openings with independent upper/lower lids and brow roots.
parts.topology: Near/far eye curves remain distinct under yaw and blink.
parts.contour_plan: Two non-identical almond openings with tapered corners; upper lid carries more weight than lower.
parts.layering_plan: Brow -> orbital wash -> upper lid -> iris/pupil -> lower lid.

parts.construction: Nose bridge, alar wings, nostrils, philtrum and small mouth tied to ANAT1 anchors.
parts.topology: Nose, moustache and lips overlap in correct order; no floating line marks.
parts.contour_plan: Use source-scale soft bridge and tip shapes, with small asymmetric nostrils.
parts.layering_plan: Nose wash -> alar shadow -> philtrum -> upper/lower lip -> moustache.

parts.construction: Separate tall squared cap with softened crown corners, front panel, side seams and woven lower band.
parts.topology: Crown, front panel and side edges overlap without rectangular sticker corners.
parts.contour_plan: Use independent curved crown and side contours from the selected sitter.
parts.layering_plan: Cap silhouette -> panel -> side seam -> band -> sparse cloth fibers.

parts.construction: Two independently rooted moustache lobes with directional taper.
parts.topology: Moustache remains separate from lips and beard substrate.
parts.contour_plan: Asymmetric upper-lip lobes with tapered outer tips.
parts.layering_plan: Upper lip shadow -> moustache mass -> fine fibers.

parts.construction: Cheek-attached beard roots, chin substrate and independent tapered strands.
parts.topology: No detached triangular beard sticker; roots attach to both cheeks and chin.
parts.contour_plan: Separate left/right cheek boundaries and central chin taper; preserve source three-quarter asymmetry.
parts.layering_plan: Cheek root wash -> chin substrate -> strand groups -> sparse lifted ends.

parts.construction: Ming robe silhouette and collar from 55.37; 52.177.8 is material technique only.
parts.topology: Neck enters robe; collar overlaps chest; sleeves cover arms with hidden overscan.
parts.contour_plan: Use source robe silhouette and fold convergence; do not copy Qing fur or blue under-robe.
parts.layering_plan: Torso -> robe -> collar bands -> sleeve folds -> ink wash and fiber.

parts.construction: Seated writer root aligned to the primary scene pose and writing-tool relationship.
parts.topology: Head, neck, arms, hands, tools and robe overlap in source order.
parts.contour_plan: Match seated head inclination and upper-body envelope from Met 2024.180.
parts.layering_plan: Robe -> neck -> head -> hair; arms/hands overlap sleeve and writing tools.

parts.construction: Source-specific head tilt and face proportions over ANAT1 deformation understructure.
parts.topology: Face, hair, ear and neck remain separate; preserve attachment through yaw and pitch.
parts.contour_plan: Use seated-writer head inclination, forehead, cheek and chin anchors; no generic oval.
parts.layering_plan: Neck behind jaw; hair mass behind face; ornament above hair; collar below neck.

parts.construction: Subtle face planes and lowered gaze; secondary portrait only informs delicate line/wash technique.
parts.topology: Unequal near/far features remain attached to the head surface.
parts.contour_plan: Source-relative contour with small asymmetries and shortened generic lower-face stretch.
parts.layering_plan: Skin wash -> orbital/cheek planes -> eyes/nose/mouth -> hairline overlap.

parts.construction: Downward gaze with independently shaped lids and minimal iris exposure.
parts.topology: Near/far eyes differ in visible width under head turn.
parts.contour_plan: Fine tapered lids; do not draw identical white ovals.
parts.layering_plan: Orbital wash -> upper lid -> iris -> lower rim.

parts.construction: Small nose and subtle mouth, attached to face planes.
parts.topology: Nose, philtrum and lip remain in source order.
parts.contour_plan: Use small low-contrast forms and source-relative asymmetry.
parts.layering_plan: Nose wash -> alar shadow -> philtrum -> soft lip.

parts.construction: Layered pinned coiffure with primary bun mass, secondary coil and visible hairline.
parts.topology: Hair masses overlap; strands root in the mass and do not float.
parts.contour_plan: Asymmetric source silhouette with deliberate negative spaces.
parts.layering_plan: Back mass -> bun -> front locks -> hairline -> fibers.

parts.construction: Floral ornament and pin embedded in the coiffure.
parts.topology: Pin enters hair mass; flower remains attached.
parts.contour_plan: Petals have unequal curvature and overlap.
parts.layering_plan: Pin behind petals; center bead above petals.

parts.construction: High layered collar with separate inner/outer bands and embroidered edge.
parts.topology: Collar overlaps neck and robe; no V-neck shortcut.
parts.contour_plan: Follow source collar height and neck contact.
parts.layering_plan: Inner band -> outer band -> robe edge -> embroidery.

parts.construction: Seated robe and sleeve masses with folds converging at the writing gesture.
parts.topology: Hands remain connected to wrists; sleeve openings hide body intersections.
parts.contour_plan: Trace source fold directions and sleeve silhouette.
parts.layering_plan: Back robe -> sleeves -> forearms/hands -> writing tools.

parts.construction: Standing secondary character with distinct scale and head inclination.
parts.topology: Head attaches to neck; neck attaches to collar; robe remains behind hands.
parts.contour_plan: Keep attendant smaller than writer and aligned behind her.
parts.layering_plan: Background robe -> neck -> head -> hair -> pin -> collar detail.

parts.construction: Separate head pitch and downward gaze over ANAT1 understructure.
parts.topology: Head and neck remain connected under pitch and yaw.
parts.contour_plan: Source-specific forehead, cheek, chin and head-tilt anchors.
parts.layering_plan: Neck -> face -> ears -> hair mass -> pin.

parts.construction: Smaller face with lowered gaze and independent jaw/neck connection.
parts.topology: Face features remain attached to head under pitch and yaw.
parts.contour_plan: Use an asymmetrical narrow oval with cheek fullness and a source-matched chin.
parts.layering_plan: Skin wash -> eyes/nose/mouth -> ear/hair overlap.

parts.construction: Downward gaze with independent near/far lid geometry.
parts.topology: Eye apertures follow the projected head and remain asymmetric.
parts.contour_plan: Fine narrow openings, no identical oval pair.
parts.layering_plan: Orbital wash -> upper lid -> iris -> lower rim.

parts.construction: Small nose, philtrum and lip forms with low-contrast ink.
parts.topology: All marks attach to face landmarks.
parts.contour_plan: Source-specific small nose and mouth; avoid a vertical nose stripe.
parts.layering_plan: Nose wash -> nostrils -> philtrum -> lip.

parts.construction: One asymmetric high bun and back hair mass, not paired symmetric coils.
parts.topology: Bun overlaps main mass; hair fibers root in the mass and flow toward the bun.
parts.contour_plan: Single dominant bun with asymmetric negative space.
parts.layering_plan: Back hair -> bun -> pin -> flower -> fine fibers.

parts.construction: One inserted hairpin with small floral ornament.
parts.topology: Pin crosses into the bun and remains attached.
parts.contour_plan: Asymmetric flower and visible pin insertion point.
parts.layering_plan: Pin behind petals; center bead above.

parts.construction: Narrow high collar with separate inner/outer bands and embroidery.
parts.topology: Collar touches neck and overlaps robe without gaps.
parts.contour_plan: Follow the standing attendant's collar height and neck angle.
parts.layering_plan: Neck -> inner collar -> outer collar -> robe -> embroidery.

parts.construction: Secondary robe and sleeve mass with distinct fold rhythm from the seated writer.
parts.topology: Arms and sleeves overlap; no disconnected hands or detached collar.
parts.contour_plan: Preserve source scale and head-to-robe ratio.
parts.layering_plan: Back robe -> sleeves -> forearms/hands -> collar detail.

parts.construction: Subtle warm paper/silk substrate with restrained fibre and pigment variation.
parts.topology: Texture is pinned in paper coordinates and does not shimmer or detach from the artwork.
parts.contour_plan: Keep grain subtle and consistent with the support in each source.
parts.layering_plan: Support base -> fibres -> pigment deposits -> painted character layers.
